title: edit-bg-guard: file edits must be sequential
desc: Blocks wkedit or Edit/Write/Update when run_in_background=true. File edits must run sequentially to avoid race conditions.
steps: SAFETY: Catches wkedit.sh/exe/cmd running in background (isBg) or Edit/Write/Update with run_in_background=true. Background file edits race each other and corrupt files.
SOLUTION: Remove run_in_background=true from the Edit/Write call. All file edits must be sequential. For wkedit, call it in a foreground Bash/PowerShell command.
PREVENTION: Never set run_in_background=true on Edit, Write, Update tools. Never chain wkedit.sh in a background Bash command. Sequential edits only -- they are fast enough.
author: claude
